title: David buys the threshing floor and builds an altar
description: At the prophet Gad's command, David goes up and buys the threshing floor from Araunah the Jebusite to build an altar to the Lord. David insists on paying the full price—fifty shekels of silver—and refuses to offer anything that has cost him nothing. He presents a burnt offering and a peace offering, and the plague stops and turns away from Israel.
